name: Puffed fried sticky rice
summary: Xôi chiên phồng is sticky rice fried until it puffs, one plate on the Cồn Phụng lunch.
origin: Cồn Phụng lunch list, Ben Tre.
howToEat: It is one of the lunch plates on the garden table at Cồn Phụng, with đuông dừa fried in butter, cá tai tượng chiên xù, lẩu mắm, cơm trái dừa, and tép rang dừa.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng.
seoTitle: Xoi chien phong — puffed sticky rice at Ben Tre
seoDescription: Xôi chiên phồng is sticky rice fried until it puffs, one plate on the Cồn Phụng lunch.
